mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_behavior_post (user_id, post_id, behavior_type, behavior_time) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{post_id}, #{behavior_type}, #{behavior_time})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_behavior_post WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND post_id = #{post_id} ORDER BY behavior_type
SELECT * FROM user_behavior_post ORDER BY user_id, post_id

SELECT p.* FROM post p INNER JOIN user_behavior_post ub ON p.id = ub.post_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{user_id} AND ub.behavior_type = 1 AND (p.visible_range = '公开' OR p.visible_range IS NULL) ORDER BY ub.behavior_time DESC

SELECT p.* FROM post p INNER JOIN user_behavior_post ub ON p.id = ub.post_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{user_id} AND ub.behavior_type = 2 AND (p.visible_range = '公开' OR p.visible_range IS NULL) ORDER BY ub.behavior_time DESC

SELECT p.* FROM post p INNER JOIN user_behavior_post ub ON p.id = ub.post_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{user_id} AND ub.behavior_type = 3 AND (p.visible_range = '公开' OR p.visible_range IS NULL) ORDER BY ub.behavior_time DESC

SELECT ub.* FROM user_behavior_post ub WHERE ub.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ub2.user_id FROM user_behavior_post ub1 INNER JOIN user_behavior_post ub2 ON ub1.post_id = ub2.post_id WHERE ub1.user_id = #{user_id} AND ub2.user_id != #{user_id} GROUP BY ub2.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ub2.post_id) > 2 -- 至少有两个共同交互的帖子 ) AND ub.post_id NOT IN ( SELECT post_id FROM user_behavior_post WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ) ORDER BY ub.user_id, ub.behavior_time DESC

SELECT p.subject as tag, COUNT(*) as interaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type = 3 THEN 3 WHEN ub.behavior_type = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) as weighted_score FROM user_behavior_post ub INNER JOIN post p ON ub.post_id = p.id WHERE ub.user_id = #{user_id} AND p.subject IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.subject ORDER BY weighted_score DESC

SELECT HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(behavior_time)) as hour, COUNT(*) as behavior_count, behavior_type FROM user_behavior_post WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND behavior_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(behavior_time)), behavior_type ORDER BY hour
